{{Quote|From first to last, his instincts were those of a Knight, not a general.|Lord Berethon, on Lord Hoth|<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
'''Berethon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Lord]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], as well as [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], who held the title '''Lord Peregrine'''. He operated a feudal kingdom of [[Corellian Jedi]] within the war-torn regions of the Republic and stood as a bulwark against the forces of the [[New Sith|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Berethon was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He obtained the title of [[Jedi Lord]] after assuming control of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] with the intent of protecting it from invasion by the [[New Sith|Sith Empire]]. When Lord [[Hoth (Jedi Lord)|Hoth]], the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Battlemaster/Legends|battlemaster]], rallied the banners of the [[Jedi Grand Council]], Lord Berethon gathered [[Corellian Jedi|his forces]] and joined the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] in its fight against the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===Seventh Battle of Ruusan===
Leading his forces against the armies of the Brotherhood, Lord Berethon accompanied Hoth and the other Lords to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] to participate in the final [[Ruusan campaign|campaign]] against [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Skere Kaan]] and the Brotherhood. Surviving all seven major battles, Berethon and Lord [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] were the only two Lords present to survive the cataclysmic effects of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-activated [[thought bomb]]. In the aftermath of the battle, Lord Berethon was captured and taken as a prisoner by a surviving female Sith soldier, who was unaware of his identity, simply referring to him as "''Jai''". He assured her that Lord Berethon would take them under his protection, and the two engaged in a conversation about the nature of the Force and different perspectives on it, such as those of [[Thon|Master Thon]] and the [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]]. After she finally inquired as to his name, he revealed his identity, to her mild exasperation, and allowed him to use his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to reach the fleet in orbit.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

===After the war===
At some point, Like many other Lords, Berethon was ostracized by his Jedi brothers and sisters on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and retired with his warriors to his holdfast on Corellia where they would remain weary of Coruscant control for several generations.<ref name="EGTW" /> At some point, Berethon wrote his memoirs, entitled ''“I, Corellian: Ruusan and Reformation”,'' in which he described his encounter in the aftermath of Ruusan''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I also took the opportunity to explore an idea I feel is slightly underused: when Jedi knighthood becomes hereditary, an ancestral lightsaber might end up in the hands of someone who isn't very good at using the Force.|Paul Urquhart|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
Berethon was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> During the writing of the book, Urquhart also featured Berethon as a point-of-view character in a narrative segment titled "Nightfall on Ruusan," but it was cut from the final book. The segment was eventually published on [[StarWars.com]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />
